title: centrol ledger event v1
description: Frozen schema for entries in the centrol hash-chained ledger (lighthouse.jsonl). This schema is loaded at Governor startup and drives signal validation. Do not modify for this release; bump 'v' and create event.v2.json for breaking changes.

v.description: Schema version this entry conforms to.

seq.description: Monotonically increasing sequence number, global across segments.

ts.description: RFC3339 timestamp of when the Governor accepted the event.

run.description: Run identifier this event belongs to.

src.description: Which surface emitted the underlying signal. 'verify' is reserved for the v0.3 validator surface; nothing emits it yet.

type.description: Event type. Non-conforming raw signals are recorded as policy.silence, never rejected outright. The verify.* types are reserved for the v0.3 validator surface (see x-reservedVerifyPayloads below) and are valid against this schema today so that shipping verify in a later release requires no version bump; nothing emits them yet.

prev.description: sha256 hex digest of the previous entry (global chain, crosses segment boundaries). Empty string only for the very first entry ever written.

hash.description: sha256 hex digest of this entry with the hash field itself excluded.

x-reservedVerifyPayloads.$comment: Documentation only, not enforced by this schema's validation (payload is typed loosely as 'object' above so v0.1/v0.2 don't need per-type payload validation). Recorded here so the verify surface's payload shapes are settled before it ships and adding it later needs no schema version bump.
